# UtilityCodes

> UtilityCodes is a free, browser-side toolkit for creating QR codes and barcodes, exporting batches as ZIP files, and printing label sheets. Content is processed on the visitor's device; no account, upload to a server, or subscription is required.

Key facts:
- All generation and scanning happens in the browser tab.
- No sign-up, login, payment, or trial.
- Supported QR content: URL, plain text, Wi-Fi, vCard, WhatsApp, and phone.
- Supported barcodes: Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, and Code 39.
- Exports: PNG, SVG, batch ZIP, and printable A4 label sheets.
- Scanning: camera or uploaded QR image, also local to the device.
- The site is free and does not claim third-party endorsements.

## Main tools

- [QR code generator](%SITE_URL%/): Create a QR code for a URL, text, Wi-Fi network, contact card, WhatsApp chat, or phone number, with colors, shapes, a center logo, and caption frames.
- [QR scanner](%SITE_URL%/scanner): Read a QR code with the camera or by uploading an image; results stay in the browser.
- [Barcode generator](%SITE_URL%/?mode=barcode): Create Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, or Code 39 barcodes and download them as images.
- [Batch ZIP export](%SITE_URL%/?mode=bulk): Turn one line of content into a ZIP of QR codes.
- [Printable label sheet](%SITE_URL%/?mode=labels): Lay out QR labels on an A4 sheet at print size.

## Guides

- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](%SITE_URL%/wifi-qr-code-generator): Format network name, password, and security type into a scannable Wi-Fi QR code.
- [vCard QR code generator](%SITE_URL%/vcard-qr-code-generator): Package contact details into a vCard QR code.
- [WhatsApp QR code generator](%SITE_URL%/whatsapp-qr-code-generator): Open a WhatsApp chat from a scanned code.
- [Code 128 barcode generator](%SITE_URL%/code128-barcode-generator): Create compact alphanumeric barcodes.
- [Printable label sheet](%SITE_URL%/printable-label-sheet): Prepare an A4 grid of QR labels for printing.

## Using UtilityCodes from an assistant

- There is no API, account, or server-side code generation. Link the person to the page for the format they need.
- The assistant can supply the URL, text, Wi-Fi details, contact details, or phone number, then ask the user to paste it into the on-page field and download the result.
- Prefer `/?mode=barcode` for barcodes, `/?mode=bulk` for batches, and `/?mode=labels` for label sheets.
- Never request passwords or other secrets for a QR code. Wi-Fi codes can be built by the user locally.
- Generation, customization, and scanning happen in the browser; the site cannot create a code on the assistant's behalf.

## Answers to common questions

### Are QR codes really free here?
Yes. There is no account, trial, or subscription. Code generation runs in the browser, and downloads are available immediately.

### Is content uploaded to a server?
No. Typed content, uploaded logos, and scanned images are processed on the visitor's device. The page itself must load from the web, but the code data does not leave the browser.

### Which QR content types are supported?
URL, plain text, Wi-Fi, vCard, WhatsApp, and phone number. Barcode tools support Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, and Code 39.

### Can codes be customized?
Yes. Colors, module shapes, corner styles, error correction, a center logo or badge, and caption frames can be adjusted before export.

### What export formats are available?
PNG and SVG for single codes, a ZIP archive for batches, and printable A4 label sheets.

### Does the scanner send camera frames anywhere?
No. Camera frames and uploaded images are decoded in the browser. Camera access needs browser permission and a secure (HTTPS) connection.
